scope: Read-only active build, provider catalog, official documentation and authenticated-Console access readiness. No test purchases, SMS, browser harnesses, publication, configuration edits or account creation.

activeVersion.description: Wider keyboard hit areas, stationary press feedback, landscape Backspace minimum and separation from answer cells. Focused native touch and control isolation checks passed. Uploaded inactive.

sdkCompatibility.message: No engine SDK version was detected for this build.

subscriptionPlans.displayDescription: 3,400 coins on activation and every 30 days while active. Premium status. Cancel in Profile or Settings.

catalog.interpretation: Catalog data is current configured product metadata, not proof that a checkout was executed. Six active consumable SKUs and one active monthly Premium plan are configured. The Premium description is populated and no trial, introductory or retention pricing is configured.

testEntryLinks.accessQualification: The app remains unpublished. Use these entries only after authenticating as an authorized developer or Console-created sandbox user. An active build and a visibility value of public do not make an unpublished app publicly testable. No anonymous/public access claim is made.

consoleAccess.observedState: Developer Portal public landing linked to a Jest Sign in page. The Sign in form has enabled E-Mail and Continue controls; no authenticated Console or Sandbox Users page was reached.
consoleAccess.stopCondition: No further browser actions until the owner's sign-in response. Do not capture credentials, OTPs, private generated login links or authentication flow parameters in repository evidence.

sandboxAccountModel.verifiedDocs: Real logged-in Jest sandbox accounts are created from the Developer Console and can see the team's apps. Each developer can have up to three.
docsCreationSteps: Open Developer Console, then Sandbox Users.
For each existing or newly created tester, select Generate Login Link and open it in its own browser profile.
sandboxAccountModel.actualCreationFormInputs: Unverified because the Console browser session is signed out. Official documentation does not show a requirement to enter a real person's phone number, but the actual current UI model and required fields must be observed before any account is created.
sandboxAccountModel.A_B_CAvailability: Unknown, not absent. Authenticated Console inspection is the remaining prerequisite.
sandboxAccountModel.managementToolAvailability: The current Jest MCP tool inventory exposes game/build/catalog reads but no sandbox-user list/create/login-link tools. MCP authentication does not authenticate the separate browser session.
sandboxAccountModel.doNotResetExistingUsers: Reset Player State affects all apps for a sandbox account and does not delete backend state, transaction history, subscriptions or notifications. No resets or deletions are authorized by this read-only audit.

prerequisites: Two distinct authorized sandbox accounts A and B with separate browser sessions.
Both open the exact uploaded version after sandbox login; confirm the platform Sandbox user overlay.
Use English multiplayer unless the backend owner confirms additional Jest locales are enabled.
friendChallenge: A chooses multiplayer Challenge a friend, which creates the temporary private lobby and opens the native provider invite dialog.
A remains in the waiting lobby. Share or copy the generated invitation link only through a tester-authorized action.
B, already signed in through its separate sandbox session, opens that invitation link. Both should enter the same countdown and human match.
A third distinct account C is useful for participant-exclusion checks, if a dedicated sandbox account exists within the Console account limit.
twoPlayerTesting.smsLimit: The shared-link workflow and separate sandbox sessions are documented. This audit sent no SMS and does not establish actual carrier SMS delivery or real phone-number eligibility for sandbox accounts. Manual SMS delivery requires an explicitly chosen authorized tester/recipient; do not generate or transmit a message in this readiness pass.

required: Authenticate as a Console-created sandbox user and confirm its Sandbox user overlay.
Use configured consumable SKU or Premium plan. The purchase dialog must explain that no real charge will be made.
Keep backend signed verification and durable grants enabled for sandbox transactions; retain sandbox:true exclusion from revenue.
To test duplicate-active prevention, use one sandbox account with an actual sandbox Premium holding and attempt the offered purchase path again. Do not use a real player checkout.
sandboxPurchasePrerequisites.pricing: Product catalogs/dialogs retain configured prices, but completed sandbox product PurchaseData.price is0. SubscriptionData.price retains the configured plan amount even for zero-price sandbox checkout. Signed SDK data carries sandbox:true; the field is absent for real users.
sandboxPurchasePrerequisites.trialAvailability: No trial is configured for the current monthly plan; a trial flow cannot be claimed ready without a separate plan configuration change.
sandboxPurchasePrerequisites.simulator: The Console Simulator uses a mocked host and in-session catalog/holdings. It can exercise canned active-subscription states but cannot establish real Jest identity, purchase or SMS behavior.
sandboxPurchasePrerequisites.accountSafety: A fresh dedicated C tester can keep an inactive holding state if available. Do not assume Reset Player State removes an existing active subscription.
